spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Sakyans, near Kapilavatthu in the Banyan Tree Monastery.

entries.subject: time I

spans.text: Mahānāma, this one time I was staying near Rājagaha, on the Vulture’s Peak Mountain.
